name: Priestess A'moora
summary: Within Darnassus, Priestess A'moora serves Elune in the Temple of the Moon. She tends its rites and sacred offerings, including one tied to the fate of Lady Sathrah.

sections.title: A Servant of Elune
sections.body: Priestess A'moora tends the rites of Elune in Darnassus. Within the Temple of the Moon, she serves the spiritual needs of the city and keeps the old devotions alive. While other members of the Sisterhood oversee defenses or diplomacy, A'moora attends to sacred matters concerning Teldrassil's natural spirits.

sections.title: Tears of the Moon
sections.body: Lady Sathrah was a great spider beloved of Elune, and the temple kept her silvery dew for its healing powers. When Sathrah fell into madness, A'moora sent young adventurers to the northern borders of Teldrassil near Wellspring Lake to end her suffering and bring back her silvery spinnerets. At the temple's fountain, the spinnerets are offered to Elune so Sathrah may be reborn at peace.

faq.q: Where can I find Priestess A'moora?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora is inside the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, the capital city in Teldrassil's canopy. She stands among the priestesses who serve Elune's altar.

faq.q: What is Priestess A'moora's role in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora belongs to the Sisterhood of Elune and oversees religious ceremonies and sacred offerings. She guides travelers through rites of cleansing and sacrifice on Teldrassil.

faq.q: What quests does Priestess A'moora offer?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora sends adventurers to end the suffering of the maddened spider Lady Sathrah near Wellspring Lake. Then they offer Sathrah's silvery spinnerets to Elune at the temple's fountain.

faq.q: How is Priestess A'moora related to the Temple of the Moon?
faq.answer: Priestess A'moora attends the Temple of the Moon, the spiritual heart of night elf culture, ruled by High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. She helps with spiritual instruction and the temple's rites.

faq.q: Who is Sathrah, and why does A'moora speak of her?
faq.answer: Lady Sathrah is a great spider once beloved of Elune, dwelling near Wellspring Lake on Teldrassil's northern borders. Since Sathrah fell into madness, A'moora asks adventurers to end her suffering and offer her spinnerets to Elune so she may be reborn at peace.

faq.q: Does A'moora belong to the Alliance?
faq.answer: Yes. Priestess A'moora is a night elf priestess in Darnassus and is aligned with the Alliance. She will not aid members of the Horde.

angles.text: For night elves, Priestess A'moora keeps Elune's old traditions alive, linking Teldrassil's young boughs to their people's ancient spiritual heritage.
Priests in the Temple of the Moon can look to A'moora as an example of devotion, joining temple rites with the natural world beyond the city gates.
Priestess A'moora helps Alliance travelers explore Darnassus and learn the sacred customs of the Sisterhood of Elune.
